## Apple — Operating Margin, Last 8 Quarters

| Quarter ended | Operating income | Revenue | Operating margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2024-09-28 (FQ4'24) | $29,591M | $94,930M | 31.17% *(derived)* |
| 2024-12-28 (FQ1'25) | $42,832M | $124,300M | 34.46% |
| 2025-03-29 (FQ2'25) | $29,589M | $95,359M | 31.03% |
| 2025-06-28 (FQ3'25) | $28,202M | $94,036M | 29.99% |
| 2025-09-27 (FQ4'25) | $32,427M | $102,466M | 31.65% *(derived)* |
| 2025-12-27 (FQ1'26) | $50,852M | $143,756M | 35.37% |
| 2026-03-28 (FQ2'26) | $35,885M | $111,184M | 32.28% |
| 2026-06-27 (FQ3'26) | $35,695M | $109,417M | 32.62% |

**Provenance note:** the two September quarters (2024-09-28 and 2025-09-27) are flagged as **derived** — the operating income and revenue inputs were synthesized as FY minus Q1–Q3 (filed 2025-10-31), not taken from a directly filed Q4 fact. The other six quarters come straight from filed `OperatingIncomeLoss` and `RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax` tags in the 10-Qs filed on the dates shown.

### What the trend shows

- **Strong seasonality dominates the quarter-to-quarter pattern.** The December quarter is the peak in both years (34.46% in FQ1'25, 35.37% in FQ1'26), while the June quarter sits at the low end.
- **Year-over-year, every quarter improved.** Comparing like fiscal quarters: 31.17% → 31.65% (Sept), 34.46% → 35.37% (Dec), 31.03% → 32.28% (Mar), 29.99% → 32.62% (June). The June-quarter comparison is the widest gap in the set.
- **The trough has lifted.** The low point of the earlier four quarters was 29.99% (June 2025); the low point of the most recent four is 32.28% (March 2026).

### The driver: gross margin, not opex leverage

Gross margin expanded steadily and monotonically across the window — 46.22% (Sept 2024, derived) → 46.88% → 47.05% → 46.49% → 47.18% (derived) → 48.16% → 49.27% → 50.06% (June 2026), crossing 50% in the most recent quarter. Operating margin rose by considerably less than gross margin over the same span, which indicates operating expenses grew faster than revenue and partially absorbed the gross-margin gains.

Net margin followed a similar shape: 15.52% (Sept 2024, derived — depressed relative to its operating margin, consistent with a one-off below-the-line charge in that period) then 29.23%, 25.99%, 24.92%, 26.80% (derived), 29.28%, 26.60%, 27.23%.
